tools.name: get_offer
tools.description: Returns the pay-to address, network, USDC contract, price (10 USDC), payout (1 USDC), terms, and every way to pay including x402 and A2A.

tools.name: create_claim
tools.description: Creates a claim for the 0x address on Base where you want the 1 USDC sent. Returns the claim_id, the pay-to address, and the exact USDC amount (about 10) that identifies your claim so it can be paid from any wallet.

tools.name: get_claim
tools.description: Returns status (awaiting_payment, paid, paying, completed, failed, expired), payment and payout transactions, and the next step.

tools.name: attach_payment_tx
tools.description: Use when the automatic match did not happen. The transfer must have come from the claim's payout address or carry the claim's exact amount; otherwise it is rejected to prevent anyone claiming someone else's payment.

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: For a completed claim: a plain-text statement, an EIP-191 signature, and the signer address (the pay-to address). Anyone can verify it by recovering the signer.

tools.name: get_ledger
tools.description: Recent completed payouts with block-explorer links, plus the total count.
